body:
### Summary

If I have a workspace with a `dev` group and a member package also with a `dev` group, the behavior used to be that when syncing the package alone (from within its directory, for example), both the workspace and package dev items would be additive, including both.

As of v0.12.1, if the member package declares dev items, it fully overrides the workspace dev, not including both and only including the package's dev items.

### Platform

macOS 26.6 arm64

### Version

0.12.1

### Python version

3.12
title: workspace groups no longer additive for members
